plugin.name: hide-cursor
plugin._long: A plugin that allows to toggle hide mouse cursor.

option.name: hide_delay
option._short: Delay (in ms) before cursor will be hidden
option._long: The delay in ms before the plugin will hide the cursor. The cursor is shown again when cursor motion happens.

option.name: disabled_for
option._long: Disables cursor hiding for windows matching the specified criteria.
